title: propose-hypothesis input
description: Everything the hypothesizer is allowed to see: the signature, the retrieved context, the code, and the device's limits.

context_md.description: The file retrieve-knowledge wrote. Rules, patterns, anti-patterns and past experiments.

parent.description: Version identifier the experiment starts from, e.g. best@exp-0137.

unavailable_metrics.description: Canonical metrics this device cannot produce. A card naming one is rejected.

noise_threshold.description: This device's measured A/A threshold; a predicted speedup at or below it is not worth a round.

previous_cards.description: Cards already tried for this signature, so a dead end is not re-proposed.

candidate_index.description: Which ranked candidate to expand on this call; the regression cases use it to make one case one deterministic card.
